summary: Created ten private MY SGG Home hero candidates with the Codex built-in OpenAI Image 2.0 workflow using approved Creator Kit identity references for canonical GOD and OTOMO pairs. Each final 1672x941 scene was substantively rebuilt for the current desktop copy zone and approximate 390x630 mobile object-fit crop, and all ten passed visual checks for pair identity, named OTOMO form, two-character count, family-safe framing, and absence of standalone text or watermark. The batch records prompts, rights evidence, reference and output hashes, form balance, desktop and mobile contact sheets, and rejected-iteration reasons. All files remain CANDIDATE assets outside public runtime paths; no owner selection, approval, UI integration, commit, push, deployment, access change, or production mutation occurred.
current_objective: Preserve the unchanged owner-only production deployment while the SGG project owner reviews the ten private Image 2.0 Home hero candidates, selects a preferred direction, and separately approves any selected asset before runtime integration.

active_work.objective: Select and approve one MY SGG Home hero direction from the ten private responsive Image 2.0 candidates before any UI or production change.
acceptance_criteria: Record the owner-selected candidate number or a concrete shortlist.
Perform any requested final Image 2.0 refinement without directly copying a reference asset.
Create a separate owner approval record for the exact final file and hash.
Only after approval, integrate the exact approved asset and verify the current desktop and mobile Home views in a new muted Codex in-app browser tab.

next_actions.action: Review the desktop and mobile comparison sheets, choose one candidate or a concrete shortlist, then record exact-file owner approval before any Home UI integration.
When Codex in-app browser control is available, open the deployed URL in a new muted tab, preserve the existing protected tab, and complete visual, responsive, interaction, and console QA.
Complete a real DM code login and two-account isolation check with two consenting Discord test identities before any audience expansion.
Upgrade to stable Next and Cloudflare or Miniflare versions that officially support patched Sharp, then remove the temporary non-reachable exception.
Implement side-effect-free, audience-bound, replay-protected player snapshot bridges for each game before showing personal progress or assets.
Request and record separate authority before public or shared access, a custom domain, search indexing, or added viewers and groups.

blockers.description: This Codex task does not expose the mandatory in-app browser control or open_in_codex capability. The existing protected browser tab remains untouched, and Version 11 has been verified through production HTTP API and asset smoke but not an interactive rendered browser or console session.
blockers.resolution_required: Expose the supported Codex in-app browser control capability; open the exact live URL in a new muted tab without navigating the protected tab and complete dashboard, Passport, responsive, asset, focus, and console verification.

blockers.description: Automated tests and production smoke cover the DM protocol and fail-closed guards, but no real user DM was sent and a two-account isolation test requires interactive access to two consenting Discord identities.
blockers.resolution_required: Run one real ordinary-player DM login and confirm two distinct Discord accounts cannot read each other's Passport or ledger data before expanding access beyond the current owner-only site.

blockers.description: Stable Next and Miniflare still require Sharp 0.34.5, which npm audit flags for inherited libvips advisories. The built Worker has no Sharp or libvips import and the application has no untrusted image-processing path, so the documented owner-only non-reachable exception remains in force.
blockers.resolution_required: Upgrade when stable Next and Cloudflare or Miniflare officially support patched Sharp; reassess immediately if image upload or server-side untrusted processing is added.

blockers.description: No game currently exposes the required side-effect-free signed player snapshot contract, so personal progress and holdings remain intentionally unconnected.
blockers.resolution_required: Implement and review the documented short-lived audience-bound assertion and player snapshot contract per game before connecting personal data.

blockers.description: Version 11 is deployed successfully with owner-only private access, but public or shared access, custom domain attachment, search indexing, extra viewers or groups, and public release remain unauthorized.
blockers.resolution_required: Record separate explicit owner authority and satisfy the release identity, privacy, domain, rollback, real-account isolation, dependency, and actual-screen gates before any audience expansion.
